title: The Last Battle
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: A false Aslan is paraded by a cunning ape, and King Tirian and a few loyal friends try to save Narnia as the world nears its end.
readIf: you have read the rest of Narnia and want to see how the series closes.
skipIf: you want a stand-alone book or are looking for an upbeat finish.
